images.title: A wall chart at 4 feet 6 inches
images.purpose: Show a height read in feet and inches: a child standing against a wall chart with the head mark at 4 feet 6 inches, which is 54 inches.
images.composition: A tall wall chart with foot marks, a child beside it, a purple mark at the head and the read-out.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. CHART: one tall wooden strip 160 px wide and 660 px high (x 560 to 720, y 90 to 750) filled amber #E69F00. MARKS: exactly 6 long tick marks (60 px wide) at the foot marks every 120 px from the bottom, at y 750, 630, 510, 390, 270 and 150, labelled to the left in 36 px bold 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 with the caption feet at the top (x 480, y 70); between the long ticks exactly 11 short ticks (30 px wide) every 10 px for the inches. CHILD: a flat figure standing on the ground line (y 750) at the right of the chart: a head circle 70 px across, a body filled teal #0072B2 and two legs, 540 px tall in all, so the top of the head is at y 210, which is the 4 feet 6 inches level (the 4 feet mark at y 270 and 6 inches above it at y 210). HEAD MARK: one reddish purple #CC79A7 horizontal line 300 px long from x 560 to x 860 at y 210 with a dot of 20 px at the child's head, and the label 4 feet 6 inches in 44 px bold at x 1000, y 195. READ-OUT: a green #009E73 rounded box 520 by 90 px (x 920 to 1440, y 300 to 390) with the text 4 × 12 + 6 = 54 inches in 44 px bold. In all: 1 chart, 6 long ticks, 1 child, 1 head mark. All shapes are flat fills with thin dark #2B2B2B outlines (3 px), no shadows and no gradients; all text is dark #1F2937 sans-serif. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
any child height other than the one stated
images.takeaway: 1 foot = 12 inches, so 4 feet 6 inches is 54 inches.
images.description: A wall chart with foot marks and a child whose head is at 4 feet 6 inches, written 4 × 12 + 6 = 54 inches.
images.context: Concept image for Feet and Inches. It follows the idea of the height chart in your maths book (a child standing against a scale in feet and inches) and shows the concept's own example of 4 feet 6 inches (practice values).
images.teaching_notes: Read the foot mark first and then the inches above it. The slip to watch: using 10 inches for a foot.
